name: ClinuxFlowAffiliatePractitionerRole
title: ClinuxFlow Affiliate Practitioner Role
description: A visiting/consulting practitioner's role at a facility that is NOT their home facility — the real, already-shipped 'Affiliates' tab in TeamSettingsModal.vue (practitionerEmail + role, via /api/facility/affiliates), formalized as FHIR. Same base resource as ClinuxFlowProviderRole (PractitionerRole) — the two profiles differ in which relationship they represent, not in shape: a Provider's own ProviderRole is their home-facility employment; this is a reference INTO someone else's own, independently-registered Practitioner (SPEC-24's own real modeling point: 'Affiliate' names two different FHIR shapes — this is the practitioner-level one; ClinuxFlowAffiliateOrganization is the organization-level one).

element.comment: A visiting arrangement is far more likely to be time-bounded than a home role — kept optional (not every visiting arrangement has a known end date) but genuinely more relevant here than on ClinuxFlowProviderRole.

References the visiting practitioner's OWN Practitioner resource — most likely their own individual-practitioner registration elsewhere, not a record this facility owns or created. No targetProfile constraint to ClinuxFlowProvider specifically: an affiliate's own Practitioner record may not even conform to this tenant's own profile.
The facility they're visiting/consulting AT — this profile's whole reason to exist.

TeamSettingsModal.vue's existing 'role' field (freetext today, e.g. 'Visiting Cardiologist') — kept as a real CodeableConcept.text here rather than forcing it through the same coded HPR role table ClinuxFlowProviderRole uses (an external affiliate's own role framing isn't this facility's to code).
